data_requirements.historical_candidate_reconstruction: At each cutoff reconstruct delisted/listed universe, dated sector taxonomy/membership, financial revisions, source/available/retrieved clocks, raw/action-adjusted series and benchmarks. No current candidates backfill. Save excluded and unknown members with reasons.
data_requirements.selection_scope: Three engineering symbols remain diagnostic pilot; whole-market reconstruction requires explicit scope/license approval.

protocol.training: Expanding from first36months; validation/test each advance6months. Exact dates require admitted exchange calendar.
protocol.boundary_rule: Drop training/validation labels crossing next interval; exclude40 actual sessions adjacent to next fold; embargo40 after holdout before reusing observations. Split by session across all stocks, never random row split.
protocol.effective_sample_warning: Five calendar years alone may not leave enough usable windows after warmup1260/labels40/purge/embargo. Publish feasible windows before any run, never shrink requirements to force a result.
protocol.freeze: Freeze input snapshots, config+code hashes, universe+membership, windows, fees, objective, all variant IDs and exposure registry before computing outcomes.
protocol.sealed_test_custody: Independent custodian; evidence that labels were inaccessible; previously exposed interval remains retrospective regardless of new PIT.

baseline.entry_exit_portfolio_adapter: UNSET_REQUIRED; new experimental StrategySpec reference, never mutate Frozen v1

optimization_candidate.fit_scope: train data for feature policies; validation12months selects thresholdpair, then seal for next6months; no selecting from sealedtest or existing revealed Lite data
optimization_candidate.objective: Highest validation mean session net benchmark excess under PESSIMISTIC dated cost; ties lower MDD, then lower turnover, then numeric sector threshold ascending, stock threshold ascending. Negative scores remain negative; no deleting failures.

ablations.change: Remove sector screening threshold only; keep stock sector-benefit weight and evidence; measures filter contribution.
Neutralize fundamental factor at50 with explicit ABLATED flag; keep hard gates and required data; do not reweight remaining factors.
Neutralize catalyst factor at50; preserve negative-event hard gates and counterevidence.
Suppress counterevidence soft ranking contribution only via material_uncertainty penalty; hard negatives, invalidation and missing evidence STILL BLOCK. Evidence is still collected, not hidden.
Remove extra entry-timing filter in future experimental adapter; retain next-session execution, T+1, halt/limit/lot/cash/fee rules; timing factor still recorded.
40-session time exit proposal; retain hard-risk exits and untradeable blocked-exit exposure; no retroactive fills.
Equal-weight eligible symbols within the same Owner-approved gross/sector/position caps; never relax caps or shared cash.

comparison_design: Nine threshold candidates validation-only; baseline+selected thresholds+7one-at-a-time ablations =>9reported test arms per window. Ablations compare to baseline, not optimized winner; paired session samples. No undisclosed combinations.

statistics.unit: joint exchange sessions; overlapping labels/trades never IID
statistics.multiplicity: 9testarms Bonferroni alpha0.05/9; report simultaneous intervals plus all9validation grid cells, no isolated winner pvalue
statistics.insufficient_sample: INCONCLUSIVE; freeze minimum effective blocks before run; currently UNSET_REQUIRED
statistics.primary_result: No success declaration until Owner approves economic criteria, sample adequacy and uncertainty estimator; statistical implementation not included this round

required_owner_decisions: risk penalty definitions and evidence coding
experimental execution adapter and actual window dates
stop_rule: No formal backtest, optimizer, Forward reveal or real capital execution in this round. Save failed windows and registrations append-only.
